t: A low-power Bluetooth and Thread chip with roomy memory for battery gadgets.
steps: Buy a Seeed Studio XIAO nRF54LM20A for about 10 US dollars, or the Sense version for about 17.
Install Visual Studio Code with the nRF Connect extension, or install PlatformIO.
Follow the Seeed wiki getting started guide to set up Zephyr for the XIAO.
Build and flash the blinky sample to flash the RGB LED.
Try a Bluetooth beacon sample and find it with a phone scanner app.
Add a sensor and send its readings over Bluetooth.
meta: Open Board. From $9.90. A few stores.
